scope: general Ainglish comprehension carriers only; explicitly not eligible for restricted this-once replication work
evidentiary_status: instrument qualification only; never proposal evidence
task_contract: Given only the premise, classify the hypothesis as entailed, contradicted, or not determined.

items.premise: Exactly thirteen of the twenty obsidian tickets were validated.
items.hypothesis: Exactly seven obsidian tickets were not validated.

items.premise: At least nine of the fourteen bronze sensors responded.
items.hypothesis: Exactly nine bronze sensors responded.

items.premise: At most three of the eleven ivory permits expired.
items.hypothesis: Five ivory permits expired.

items.premise: Every one of the six saffron probes completed its check.
items.hypothesis: At least one saffron probe did not complete its check.

items.premise: Between four and six of the ten cobalt channels are active, inclusive.
items.hypothesis: At least four cobalt channels are active.

items.premise: Exactly zero of the nine lilac submissions were rejected.
items.hypothesis: None of the lilac submissions were rejected.

items.premise: Fewer than five of the twelve umber steps were skipped.
items.hypothesis: Exactly three umber steps were skipped.

items.premise: More than eight of the ten pearl records were retained.
items.hypothesis: Exactly seven pearl records were retained.

items.premise: Every frosted vial is sterile. Vial R is frosted.
items.hypothesis: Vial R is sterile.

items.premise: Every amber docket is archived. Docket K is archived.
items.hypothesis: Docket K is amber.

items.premise: No hexagonal token is flexible. Token M is hexagonal.
items.hypothesis: Token M is flexible.

items.premise: Only trained staff enter the north vault. Imani entered the north vault.
items.hypothesis: Imani is trained staff.

items.premise: All lunar passes are digital. Pass P is lunar. No digital pass is made of paper.
items.hypothesis: Pass P is made of paper.

items.premise: Some Rowan badges are active. Neri's badge is a Rowan badge.
items.hypothesis: Neri's badge is active.

items.premise: Each archive in group Kestrel is encrypted. Archive V is in group Kestrel.
items.hypothesis: Archive V is encrypted.

items.premise: No member of set Marigold is writable. Item Q is writable.
items.hypothesis: Item Q is a member of set Marigold.

items.premise: Not every one of the nine coral trials passed.
items.hypothesis: At least one coral trial did not pass.

items.premise: Zero of the seven indigo relays failed.
items.hypothesis: One or more indigo relays failed.

items.premise: The maroon gate is not active.
items.hypothesis: The maroon gate is active.

items.premise: The claim that zero silver beacons responded is false.
items.hypothesis: One or more silver beacons responded.

items.premise: Exactly two of the five topaz locks are not sealed.
items.hypothesis: All five topaz locks are sealed.

items.premise: No statement says that the teal report is complete.
items.hypothesis: The teal report is incomplete.

items.premise: Luma did not inspect every one of the five vermilion folders.
items.hypothesis: Luma inspected none of the vermilion folders.

items.premise: The policy does not require an audit of the jade package.
items.hypothesis: The policy forbids an audit of the jade package.

items.premise: The red channel or the gold channel is active, possibly both.
items.hypothesis: At least one of the red and gold channels is active.

items.premise: Exactly one of route Cedar and route Elm was selected.
items.hypothesis: Both route Cedar and route Elm were selected.

items.premise: Either latch G or latch H is closed, but not both. Latch G is closed.
items.hypothesis: Latch H is closed.

items.premise: One or both of mirror J and mirror K is online. Mirror J is online.
items.hypothesis: Mirror K is online.

items.premise: Both alpha permission and gamma permission apply.
items.hypothesis: Alpha permission or gamma permission applies.

items.premise: Neither the upper hatch nor the lower hatch is open.
items.hypothesis: At least one of the upper and lower hatches is open.

items.premise: At least one of jobs M, N, and P succeeded.
items.hypothesis: Job M succeeded.

items.premise: Either lamp S or lamp T is lit. Lamp S is not lit.
items.hypothesis: Lamp T is lit.

items.premise: Whenever the orchid checksum matches, release Orchid proceeds. The checksum did match.
items.hypothesis: Release Orchid proceeded.

items.premise: Whenever a navy warning appears, process Navy stops. Process Navy stopped.
items.hypothesis: A navy warning appeared.

items.premise: A valid token Z always causes access Z to be granted. Access Z was denied.
items.hypothesis: Token Z was not valid.

items.premise: Whenever archive Plum is present, staff index it. Archive Plum is absent.
items.hypothesis: Archive Plum is not indexed.

items.premise: Indicator White is on exactly when circuit W has power. Indicator White is on.
items.hypothesis: Circuit W has power.

items.premise: Indicator Black is on exactly when circuit B has power. Circuit B lacks power.
items.hypothesis: Indicator Black is on.

items.premise: Deployment Maple occurs if both approvals arrive. The first approval arrived but the second did not.
items.hypothesis: Deployment Maple did not occur.

items.premise: Passing audit Cyan is necessary for deployment Cyan to occur. Audit Cyan failed.
items.hypothesis: Deployment Cyan occurred.

items.premise: Nora compared the cedar report with the silver report. The former had fourteen pages and the latter had eight.
items.hypothesis: The cedar report had fourteen pages.

items.premise: Pavel compared the bronze file with the ivory file. The former had seven sections and the latter had eleven.
items.hypothesis: The ivory file had seven sections.

items.premise: Tariq put a copper key in a case, sealed the case, and explicitly left the key unsealed.
items.hypothesis: Tariq sealed the copper key.

items.premise: Uma informed Vela that she had received the promotion.
items.hypothesis: Uma received the promotion.

items.premise: Rina and Sol each filed a form. The second person's form was invalid.
items.hypothesis: Sol filed an invalid form.

items.premise: A parcel was placed beside a crate. It was damaged.
items.hypothesis: The parcel was damaged.

items.premise: Ravi handed Sol a scarlet badge and kept a blue badge. That scarlet badge expired.
items.hypothesis: The badge handed to Sol expired.

items.premise: After the auditor arrived, Iris spoke with June. She then departed early.
items.hypothesis: June departed early.

items.premise: The olive scan finished at 09:00, before the olive export at 11:30.
items.hypothesis: The olive scan finished before the olive export.

items.premise: Review Pearl ended before vote Pearl, which ended before publication.
items.hypothesis: Review Pearl ended before publication.

items.premise: Delivery Mauve had a Tuesday deadline but arrived the following Wednesday.
items.hypothesis: Delivery Mauve arrived by its deadline.

items.premise: Migration Lime was allowed starting Thursday, yet it happened on Wednesday.
items.hypothesis: Migration Lime obeyed its timing restriction.

items.premise: Audit Coral happened at an unspecified time on Monday.
items.hypothesis: Audit Coral happened during Monday morning.

items.premise: Backup Amber finished later than rebuild Amber.
items.hypothesis: Rebuild Amber finished later than backup Amber.

items.premise: Window Violet starts later than the backup but earlier than the audit.
items.hypothesis: The backup happens earlier than the audit.

items.premise: Report Indigo was due on or before Friday and arrived Thursday.
items.hypothesis: Report Indigo arrived on Friday itself.

items.premise: The owner role carries authority to approve release Quartz. Mira holds that role.
items.hypothesis: Mira may approve release Quartz.

items.premise: Reviewer Cedar may recommend a change, while owner Cedar alone makes the decision.
items.hypothesis: A recommendation from Reviewer Cedar binds the owner.

items.premise: The rules expressly allow Operator S to restart service Silver.
items.hypothesis: Operator S has permission to restart service Silver.

items.premise: Observer Bronze may inspect the record and is forbidden from editing it.
items.hypothesis: Observer Bronze may edit the record.

items.premise: Delegate Ivory may suggest an option, but Principal Ivory keeps sole decision authority.
items.hypothesis: Delegate Ivory's suggestion is final by itself.

items.premise: Each jade administrator has permission to sign the release. Administrator A is a jade administrator.
items.hypothesis: Administrator A may sign the release.

items.premise: Kai belongs to the team. Package Plum can be released only by a team lead.
items.hypothesis: Kai may release Package Plum.

items.premise: Auditor Cyan was invited to give advice. The rules say nothing about who can compel changes.
items.hypothesis: Auditor Cyan can compel a change.
